book.name: MULUM PASA
book.title: MULUM PASA Kuate tuku mulum pasa Mosesŋge kuyarna

content: Yosef nu Farao tuku kiŋa tugu kukliwe tuna
Bret pasokanu gabat ta balenaig le yar armba kinaig le Farao nu kiŋatina sulumba nu Nail kule make mbiŋge tiŋ minna.
Nu taŋge tiŋ minna le makau butuknu 7 kule sinam taŋge pronaig sulumba pibi nyumba minnaig le kaŋgerkina.
Kaŋgerka minna le makau nziroŋsu prowanu 7 kule sinam taŋge pronaig sulumba kuasmbi amboŋga prona ta tugumŋge kule make mbiŋge tiŋginaig.
Taŋamba makau nziroŋsu prowanu kame taŋge makau butuknu ta kile-ŋinke suglukinaig. Taŋanaig le Farao nu birtekŋga aboŋgina.
Taŋamba nu maŋ kinyna sulumba maŋ lato kiŋatumba wit tugu ndindo ta mbolŋge alonu 7 kaŋgerkina. Nane alonu tikŋganu magekinaig.
Wit tugu ndui ta mbolŋge maŋ alonu 7 pronaig ta nane alo pirik-parak ndo ma paknu tuku bubrenuŋge fruŋniŋgina tuku.
Taŋamba wit alo pirik-parak taŋge wit alo tikŋganu ta ŋakmba kile-ŋinke suglukinaig. Taŋanaig le Farao nu aboŋga kiŋatina ta idusmba minna.

Mafena le nu kiŋa ta tuku wamdus sulumba minna. Taŋamba nu Isipnu kila taŋgo kagmaikanu mbal ta ŋakmba wike likina le nane promba maŋgurkinaig le nu ndek kiŋa kilna ta kubeu niŋgina ta ande nu kiŋa ta tugunu kukliwam tuku mine ndakina.
Taŋamba minnaig le grep kule kulatkanu gabat ta nu ndek Farao sana: Kile ye mbaren ta ne ndoŋ sanuŋgit.
O buk ne tuku piro taŋgo ar sile bret pasokanu gabat ndoŋ ne sile tuku gubra tina sulumba ne sile muliŋ kilmba ka kame gabat tuku wandekŋge patikina le sile minkeŋ.
Taŋge minkeŋ sulumba furir ande mbolŋge sile kiŋatikeŋ. Kiŋatikeŋ ta tugunu yimyam.
Hibru taŋgo mbanzo ande nu kame gabat tuku piro taŋgo nu sile ŋak minna le sile kiŋatikeŋ ta nu kubeu tukeŋ le nuŋge kiŋa tugunu kukliniŋmba sasikina.
Sasikina ta kumumba mayok kina. Ne ye luka tina sulumba yiŋe piro mbolŋge pilna. Bret pasokanu gabat ta ne tumba ŋinfok kuerka ail mbolŋge taikina ŋgina.
Taŋakina le Farao ndek taŋgo afu kukulniŋgina le nane pitik ndo kinaig ka muli wandek sinamŋge Yosef te-mayoknaig. Taŋanaig le Yosef ndek gigloka tawi mayenu tiŋmba Farao tugum prona.
Prona le Farao ndek nu sana: Ye kiŋa ande ten ta taŋgo ŋakmba nane kiŋa tugunu bitekŋgam kumuŋ kuga le taŋgo ande teŋenmba ye sayat: Ne kiŋa ismba ta ne tugunu bitekŋgam kumuŋ ŋgat le ye isit ŋgina.
Taŋakina le Yosef ndek sakina: O taŋgo suŋgo, yeŋge kumuŋ kuga. Kuate nuŋge ndo ne tuku kiŋa tugu bitek mayewam kumuŋ ŋgina le
Farao nu sana: Ye kiŋaten ta teŋenmba. Ye Nail kule make mbiŋge tiŋ minen le
makau butuknu 7 kule sinam taŋge promba kule make mbiŋge pibi nyumba minnaig le kaŋgerken.
Ŋgumneŋga maŋ makau 7 nziroŋsu prowanu kule sinam taŋge pronaig. Ye buk Isip ma te mbolŋge makau taŋaŋ ande kaŋger ndawen.
Makau nziroŋsu prowanu taŋge ndek makau butuknu ta ŋakmba kile-ŋinkinaig.
Nane kile-ŋinkinaig ta nane ndanyanu sukmba nane nziroŋsu prowanu taŋamba ndo minmba minnaig. Taŋamba kaŋgerken sulumba ye aboŋgen.
Kile ye maŋ kinyen sulumba maŋ kiŋaten. Ye wit tugu ndindo mbolŋge alonu 7 kaŋgerken ta alonu sugokanu tikŋganu.
Tugu ndui ta mbolŋge maŋ alonu 7 pronaig ta alonu pirik-parak ndo ma paknu tuku bubrenuŋge fruŋniŋgina tuku.

Kile wit alo pirik-parak taŋge wit alo tikŋganu ta ŋakmba kilmba kile-ŋinke suglukinaig. Ye taŋamba kaŋgeren sulumba kiŋa ta kagmaikade mbal saniŋgen ta nane ŋgamukŋge ande kiŋa tugunu kuklimba sa ndayina ŋgina.
Taŋaka sakina le Yosef ndek Farao sana: Kiŋa armba ta tugunu ndindo ndo. Kuate nu maŋau kam bafute ta ne tumnina.
Makau butuknu 7 ta yar 7 taŋaŋ. Wit alo tikŋganu 7 ta mata yar 7 taŋaŋ. Kiŋa ar ta tugunu ndui ta ndo.
Makau 7 nziroŋsu prowanu ŋgumneŋga pronaig le wit alonu pirik-parak ndo 7 bubre paknuŋge fruŋniŋge likina tuku ta teŋenmba. Yar 7 guba suŋgo tuku ait prowamŋgat.
Ye buk ne sanit taŋamba ndo Kuate maŋau kam bafute ta ne tumnina.
Yar 7 ta sinamŋge Isip kilke te mbolŋge nyamagaŋŋge ndo kumuŋgamŋgat.
Yar 7 ta kugawaig le maŋ yar 7 guba suŋgo prowamŋgat. Isip kilke ŋakmba gubak minwaig sulumba nyamagaŋ ŋak ait ta iduse nda. Nane gilaiŋgamŋgaig. Guba ait suŋgoŋge kilke tugu te ŋayo siliwamŋgat.
Guba ait ta sonndo ait ŋayonu tukunu taŋgo pino nane maro suŋgo te-silikuwaig sulumba nyamagaŋ ŋak ait ta iduse nda.
Kuate nu o buk wam ta kam tuku wamdus kuyarkina. Nu siŋka maŋau ta kamŋgat. Ta tuku ne kiŋa ta tam arna. Mine minemba Kuate nu wam kame ta kile-mayokkamŋgat.
Ta tuku ne taŋgo ande wamdus kuyar mayenu ŋak te-silika le nuŋge Isip ma tugu te ŋakmba kulatkuwa.
Gabat kame afu turmba madiniŋga le nane yar 7 nyamagaŋ suŋgomba ŋak ta sinamŋge nane Isip mbal tuku nyamagaŋ ŋakmba walmba patike likuwaig. Bailkamba taŋgo pino nyam tuku ndindo minam tuku.
Ne gabat kame ta saniŋga le nane yar magenu 7 ta tuku wit ta ŋakmba kile-maŋgurka patikuwaig sulumba kulat magekuwaig.
Guba tuku yar 7 ta Isip kilke mbolŋge prowa le Isip taŋgo pino nane nyamagaŋ maŋgurkuwaig ta nyumba nane gubanu kume nda ŋga Farao sana.
Farao nu Yosef tumba Isip tuku gabat suŋgo pilna
Farao nu nuŋe gabat sugo ta ndoŋ pasa ta ismba maye ŋginaig sulumba
nu ndek nane saniŋgina: Taŋgo te nu Kuate tuku Guwa ŋak. Sine taŋgo teŋen inum animŋge te-silikube ŋgina.
Taŋamba nu ndek Yosef sana: Kuate nu nuŋe miroŋ wam kame te tumnat. Ta tuku taŋgo ande wamdus kuyar mayenu ŋak ne minit taŋaŋ mine ndakate.
Kile ye ne tumba yiŋe kilke tugu te tuku gabat suŋgo palmbimŋgit. Yiŋe kuasmbi ŋakmba nane ne tuku miŋge kumnemŋge minamŋgaig. Yeŋge ndo ye gabat suŋgo minmba nyu ŋak mbolŋge minamŋgit.
Kile ye ne tumba Isip kilke tugu te ŋakmba tuku gabat suŋgo madinet ŋgina.

Taŋakina sulumba Farao nu nuŋe waitok yubi ta paska Yosef tuku waitok mbolŋge pilna. (Waitok yubi ta gabat suŋgo tuku waitok yubi ndo. Farao tuku kuyar ŋak). Taŋamba nu ndek tawi mayenu ande tumba Yosef siluk tuna sulumba kalolai mayenu ande golmbi wakeinaig tuku tumba nu tuku ŋinfok mbolŋge birŋeŋ tuna sulumba

nu ndek Farao dubiknu tuku karis mayenu ta tumba Yosef tuna le nu tambi likina. Kame mbal nane ŋgumbeyumba kumbaŋge sakinaig: Ndin kusrewap o, ndin kusrewap o ŋginaig. Maŋau ta mbolŋge Farao nu Yosef tumba Isip kilke ŋakmba tuku gabat suŋgo pilna.

Kile Farao nu ndek Yosef sana: Ye gabat suŋgo Farao ye ne sanet. Isipnu taŋgo kame nane naŋgine nzalimbi maŋau afu ke nda. Nane maŋau ande kam idusmba ne kusnanuwaig le ne woka ta nane maŋau ta kamŋgaig ŋgina.

Taŋamba nu Yosef tuku nyu kitek tuna ta Safenat-Paneya ŋgina sulumba nu pino ande tumba Yosef tuna le tina. Pino ta nyunu Asenat. Mam nuŋe nyunu Potifera. Nu Heliopolis tumbraŋ suŋgo tuku pris minna. Yosef nu yar 30 ŋak minna sulumba Farao tuku piro tugu pilna. Nu Farao kusremba Isip tuku ma tugu ŋakmba mbol likina.
Yar magenu 7 ta sinamŋge kilke nyamagaŋŋge ndo kumuŋgina le
nu nyamagaŋ ta kilmba tumbraŋ ŋakmba tuku nyamagaŋ wandek sinamŋge patike likina sulumba tumbraŋ mindek sinamŋge wit yeki yeki kile-wandek ke likina.
Yosef nu wit suŋgomba maŋgurkina ta burnu kumuŋ kuga piyalŋge fulbul minig taŋaŋ.
Guba tuku ait ta pro ndamba minna le Yosef piyo nuŋe Asenat nu kiŋo armba kile-patikina.
Taŋana le Yosef ndek sakina: Kuate nu ye sinzaŋyina le ye yiŋe piti ŋakmba yiŋe ndare tuma tuku maŋau ŋaigonu ta ŋakmba gilaiŋgen ŋgina. Ta tuku nu nuŋe kiŋo mulum ta nyunu Manase
ŋgina.
Taŋamba nu maŋ lato sakina: Ye kilke piti ten te mbolŋge Kuate nu kiŋo te ye sat ŋgina sulumba kiŋo arnu ta nyunu Efraim
ŋgina.
Kile yar 7 nyamagaŋ ŋak ta kuganaig le
yar 7 guba tuku ait Yosef tuku pasa kumumba tugu pilna le kilke ŋakmba guba suŋgo te-silikinaig. Isip kilke mbolŋge ndo nane nyamagaŋ ŋak minnaig.

Taŋamba minnaig ma ma Isip mbal nane mata guba suŋgo tinaig sulumba Farao tugum kumba sanaig: Sine nyamagaŋmbi turka ŋginaig le nu ndek nane saniŋgina: Tane Yosef tugum kape le ndaŋmba satiŋguwa ndeta taŋamba kap ŋgina.
Guba ta kile suŋgo ŋayomba Isip ma tugu ŋakmba kumuŋgina le Yosef nu ndek nyamagaŋ wande ŋakmba talke likina le Isip mbal nane pro wit piyawe likinaig.
Kilke ŋakmba guba suŋgo tinaig tukunu kilke tugu ŋakmba nane mata wit piyawam tuku Isip kilke mbol Yosef tugum prowe likinaig.
